subject: fix(ci): avoid SIGPIPE race in launchpad upgrade assertions (#3860)
summary: Avoids SIGPIPE race conditions in the launchpad-ppa CI workflow by capturing `lemonade list --downloaded` and `lemonade config` output into shell variables before grepping, instead of piping the commands directly into grep.
